description: SaunaLife Model G11 Garden-Series Outdoor Home Sauna Kit -2 Room Sauna Experience the magic of sauna bathing and a lifetime of improved wellness with the SaunaLife Model G11 Garden-Series Outdoor Home Sauna Kit. Spacious and Comfortable The G11 Garden-Series Outdoor Home Sauna Kit is expertly designed for a luxurious sauna experience. With two spacious rooms, this sauna can comfortably accommodate both family and friends. The sauna room boasts 2-tier benching, providing ample seating for up to 8 bathers. The second room, of equal size, serves as a lounge and dressing room, complete with extra seating. A partition wall with a tempered glass door separates this room from the sauna. This unique backyard sauna kit features an organic design that complements its surroundings and seamlessly integrates with nature. The enclosed front porch features a comfortable table and benches for pre- or post-sauna relaxation. Additionally, a secondary table with storage space for firewood is available for those who prefer a traditional wood-burning sauna experience. The door and wall are adorned with large round windows, while the dressing room boasts a rectangular window for natural light. Impressively robust construction The G11 is specifically designed to withstand even the most extreme weather conditions. It comes equipped with a comprehensive shingle kit and roll-on underlayment for added protection. Beautifully illuminated Experience a touch of elegance with the optional lighting package. The white exterior LED sconce, mounted near the front door, brightens the entrance and terrace. Neon indirect white lighting behind and under the bench adds sophistication, while LED valance lights on either side of the partition wall enhance the sauna. Easily adjust the valance lights to your preferred shade of white or choose from an infinite range of colors using the included hand-held remote and wall mount. All lighting elements can also be dimmed for maximum control. Experience ultimate relaxation and rejuvenation with SaunaLife's Model G11 Garden-Series Outdoor Home Sauna Kit -2 Room Sauna. Pamper yourself and your loved ones with a luxurious sauna experience in the comfort of your own home. The G11 Black includes outdoor black paint for customer application after delivery. The paint is recommended to be reapplied annually as needed to maintain the finish. Applying the paint after delivery allows for a smooth, even finish and helps avoid scratches or nicks that can occur during LTL freight shipping.
